name: Harusaka Keisuke
source:
Penis Length: 19 cm

First-year student at St. Torea Academy.
His hobby is making sweets, and his skills are quite good. When he was a child, he was hailed as a "prodigy boy patissier'', and even appeared in a manga
and TV anime with him as the main character.
"These days I mourn that the peak of my life passed when I was a child."
Ichio's confectionery-making skills are bought, and during the summer
vacation, he works part-time as a temporary pastry chef at his aunt's ice
cream specialty shop, "Pisha Romunto".
A boy in the prime of youth who can't decide his own stance to
life, showing a philosophical view of life, but still not giving up on "something".

[Translated from [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/icegirl/char04.html]game's official website[/url]]
